titleEn: As You Bake, So Shall You Brew
titleZh: 怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果

items.promptEn: A club failed to check its booking date and arrived to find the venue taken.
items.promptZh: 社團沒有核對訂場日期，到場才發現場地已租給別人。

options.text: The club’s unchecked date led to a lost venue—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 可控制的核對疏忽引致場地問題。

options.text: The club checked the date and the venue still failed through no fault of its own—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文是沒有核對。

options.text: The club had not yet tried to book anything—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 社團已有預訂安排。

options.text: The lost venue proves every member was careless—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一項疏忽不證明人人都粗心。

items.promptEn: Ka knew the deadline but did not submit the form and missed registration.
items.promptZh: 阿佳明知截止日期仍不提交表格，結果錯過報名。

options.text: Ka’s decision not to submit led to missing registration—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 明知期限而不交，結果相連。

options.text: Ka submitted the form on time and the system lost it—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 與原文不交表格相反。

options.text: The registration deadline is still several weeks away—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文已錯過報名。

options.text: Missing one deadline proves Ka will fail forever—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一次結果不等於永久命運。

items.promptEn: Jun made no backup; when his computer failed, he had to rewrite the report.
items.promptZh: 阿俊沒有備份報告，電腦壞了後要重新寫。

options.text: Jun’s lack of a backup left him with extra work—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 沒有備份與重做報告有清楚因果。

options.text: Jun had saved several backups before the failure—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說沒有備份。

options.text: The report had never existed—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說要重新寫，代表已有報告。

options.text: The computer failure proves Jun deserved any harm—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 諺語不等於應受任何傷害。

items.promptEn: A player skipped practice for weeks and could not keep time with teammates during a performance.
items.promptZh: 球員連續數週不練習，演出時便跟不上隊友的節奏。

options.text: Skipping practice contributed to the player losing the beat—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 長期缺練習與表演困難相連。

options.text: The player practised daily but the stage speakers failed—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有每日練習或喇叭故障。

options.text: The performance had not yet happened—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 表演已發生。

options.text: The mistake proves the player has no talent at all—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一次失誤不證明完全沒天分。

items.promptEn: Man ignored the recipe, added salt instead of sugar, and the cake tasted salty.
items.promptZh: 阿文不看煮食步驟，把鹽當糖加進蛋糕，出爐後味道很鹹。

options.text: Man’s ingredient choice affected the cake he had to eat—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 用鹽代糖與蛋糕味道有直接關係。

options.text: Man followed the recipe exactly but the oven broke—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說沒照食譜。

options.text: The cake had not been baked yet—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 蛋糕已出爐。

options.text: The salty cake proves Man can never cook well—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一次失手不等於永遠不會煮食。

items.promptEn: A group kept avoiding task assignments and found two sections unwritten the night before submission.
items.promptZh: 小組一直不分工，交稿前夜才發現還有兩節沒寫。

options.text: Their failure to divide the work led to a last-minute gap—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 未分工與最後缺稿相連。

options.text: They had assigned every section from the start—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說一直不分工。

options.text: The report had already been submitted complete—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 交稿仍在明天。

options.text: The gap proves one particular member alone caused everything—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 沒有足夠資料指責特定一人。

items.promptEn: Yan repeatedly skipped tyre checks and got a puncture in a worn tyre.
items.promptZh: 阿欣反覆不檢查單車輪胎，結果在已磨損的輪胎上爆胎。

options.text: The ignored worn tyre helped bring about the puncture—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 可檢查的磨損被忽略，與爆胎相連。

options.text: Yan checked the tyres daily and a stranger damaged the bike—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說反覆不檢查。

options.text: The tyre was new and undamaged—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 輪胎已磨損。

options.text: A puncture proves Yan caused every road hazard—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 單次爆胎不代表所有風險皆由她造成。

items.promptEn: A drama group did not rehearse scene changes, and moving props took too long during the show.
items.promptZh: 戲劇組沒有排練換景，正式演出時道具移位花了很久。

options.text: Skipping scene-change practice contributed to the slow transition—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 沒有練習換景，演出時拖慢。

options.text: The group rehearsed every change and the theatre lost power—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有停電或完整排練。

options.text: The show had been cancelled before opening—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 正式演出已進行。

options.text: A slow change means the entire play was worthless—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一段轉場慢不等於全劇無價值。

items.promptEn: Long left a plant in a dark corner and did not water it; after weeks its leaves wilted.
items.promptZh: 阿朗把植物放在黑暗角落卻一直不澆水，幾週後葉子枯萎。

options.text: Long’s neglect was linked to the plant wilting—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 缺光與缺水的照料問題和枯萎相連。

options.text: Long watered it regularly in a sunny place—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說暗角又沒澆水。

options.text: The plant was still healthy after weeks—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 葉子幾週後枯萎。

options.text: Wilted leaves prove Long neglects every living thing—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一盆植物不能推斷對待所有生命。

items.promptEn: Chui did not check the timetable and reached the platform just after the last train left.
items.promptZh: 阿翠沒有查列車時間，直到月台才發現尾班車剛開走。

options.text: Not checking the timetable contributed to missing the train—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 沒查時間與錯過尾班車相連。

options.text: Chui checked the timetable but the railway changed it without notice—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 題目不是鐵路臨時改班次。

options.text: The last train had not departed—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文說尾班車剛開走。

options.text: Missing the train proves she never checks any plan—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一次疏忽不能推斷從不做計劃。

items.promptEn: May knew about tomorrow’s test but did not revise all evening, then struggled with material already taught.
items.promptZh: 阿美明知明天要考試，整晚不温習，測驗中不懂已教過的題目。

options.text: Skipping revision contributed to May’s difficulty on the test—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 可控制的不温習與已教內容答不出相連。

options.text: May revised carefully but the test covered material never taught—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文是未温習，內容已教。

options.text: The test was postponed and never held—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 測驗已舉行。

options.text: The result proves May cannot learn any subject—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 一場測驗不能代表所有學科能力。

items.promptEn: Lok did not organise his inbox; an important invitation was buried and its reply deadline passed.
items.promptZh: 阿樂一直不整理電郵，重要邀請被淹沒，回覆期限便過了。

options.text: An unorganised inbox contributed to Lok missing the deadline—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 不整理電郵與錯過回覆期限相連。

options.text: Lok sorted the inbox daily but the invitation never arrived—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 原文是邀請到達後被淹沒。

options.text: The deadline is still weeks away—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 期限已過。

options.text: Missing one invitation proves Lok is dishonest—as you bake, so shall you brew.
options.reasonZh: 漏覆不等於不誠實。

meaning.zh: 自己的做法會帶來相應後果，之後仍須面對或承擔。
meaning.en: Your actions help determine the consequences you later have to face.

model.zh: 社團沒有核對預訂日期，結果到場才發現場地已被別人租用。
model.en: The club failed to check the booking date and arrived to find the venue taken—as you bake, so shall you brew.

picture.zh: 想像自己和麵、放進焗爐，出爐後便要面對成品。
picture.en: Imagine preparing the dough and then facing the loaf that comes out of the oven.

boundary.zh: 這是較古舊的說法；不可用來責怪遭遇意外或不公的人。
boundary.en: The wording is old-fashioned; do not use it to blame people for accidents or injustice beyond their control.

where.zh: 適合談自己可控制的選擇及其相連後果；現代日常口語常改說「種瓜得瓜」。
where.en: Use it for choices within someone’s control and the connected outcome; a plainer modern saying may be easier in conversation.

tone.zh: 有勸戒意味，亦可能顯得責備；要分清責任和運氣。
tone.en: Admonitory and potentially blaming; distinguish choice from bad luck.

checks.zh: 當事人有甚麼可控制的選擇？
checks.en: What choice was within the person’s control?

checks.zh: 後果是否由那選擇引起？
checks.en: Did that choice lead to the outcome?

checks.zh: 這樣說會否錯怪受害者？

readAloud.zh: 她沒有備份重要檔案，電腦壞了後便要重新做整份報告。
readAloud.en: She made no backup, so when the computer failed she had to rewrite the report—as you bake, so shall you brew.

prompt.zh: 哪個情境有清楚的選擇與後果？
prompt.en: Which scene shows a clear choice and consequence?

options.zh: 他明知要交表格卻不填，結果錯過報名。
options.en: He knowingly leaves the form unfinished and misses registration.
options.reasonZh: 可控制的疏忽與結果相連。

options.zh: 他準時交表，卻因系統故障失去資料。
options.en: He submits on time, but a system failure loses the data.
options.reasonZh: 結果不是由他的疏忽造成。

options.zh: 他填表後等候結果，尚不知道是否獲批。
options.en: He submits the form and waits; no decision has been made.
options.reasonZh: 尚沒有可承擔的結果。

prompt.zh: 朋友因自己忘記報名而失望，哪個回應較合宜？
prompt.en: A friend is upset after forgetting to register. Which reply is useful?

options.zh: 「先看看能否補報；下次我們一起設提醒。」
options.en: “Let’s see whether late registration is possible and set a reminder next time.”
options.reasonZh: 承認後果，同時幫忙處理。

options.zh: 「怎樣做便承受怎樣的結果，所以不必幫你。」
options.en: “As you bake, so shall you brew, so I need not help you.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語不要求旁人拒絕協助。

options.zh: 「你忘了報名，證明往後所有事都會失敗。」
options.en: “Missing this registration proves you will fail at everything.”
options.reasonZh: 把一次後果誇成永久命運。

prompt.zh: 隊員一再不按時練習，正式表演時跟不上節奏。哪句貼切？
prompt.en: A player repeatedly skips practice and cannot keep time during the performance. Which line fits?

options.zh: 「他自己略過練習，表演時便跟不上；怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果。」
options.en: “He skipped practice and could not keep time—as you bake, so shall you brew.”
options.reasonZh: 選擇與相連後果均有交代。

options.zh: 「他每天練習，仍因舞台故障聽不到節拍；怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果。」
options.en: “He practised daily but a stage fault hid the beat—as you bake, so shall you brew.”
options.reasonZh: 把外來故障錯算成他的選擇後果。

options.zh: 「他略過練習，卻在表演前已獲保證一定成功；怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果。」
options.en: “He skipped practice but was guaranteed success beforehand—as you bake, so shall you brew.”
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有這項保證，也削弱因果。

prompt.zh: 哪個說法最能避免誤用？

options.zh: 「只在後果確實與可控制的行動相連時使用。」
options.en: “Use it only when the result is linked to an action the person could control.”
options.reasonZh: 限定責任，避免責怪受害者。

options.zh: 「任何不幸都證明當事人做錯事。」
options.en: “Every misfortune proves the sufferer did something wrong.”
options.reasonZh: 無端把意外或不公歸咎受影響者。

options.en: “The saying can refer only to baking and brewing.”
options.reasonZh: 忽略比喻意思。
